notes: Spearman correlations across specialty or domain categories (category-level, ecological units). Critical rate per category from 2021-2025 records; FDA counts from the list of AI/ML-enabled devices cleared 1995-2025 mapped to review panels ({{T:fda_mapping}}). The two-sided P is primary; one-sided P (alternative ρ<0) and a one-sided pairing-permutation P (10,000 permutations, seed 42) are sensitivity variants. Generative-model share is computed among abstract-present critical records and is endogenous to criticality, so the partial correlation is a sensitivity analysis, not a confounder adjustment. Structural zeros: the 7 categories with no mapped FDA panel. This is an exploratory ecological association.
